answer: No single person can move the account. Social recovery guardians puts five humans on the reset path: five guardians who must co-sign any reset. A reset needs all five signatures, so the falcon of the attack is the guardian set itself - five separate people, five devices, five lives that must all be compromised at once. The glacier in the middle is the guardian who refuses and warns the other four. The pulse that finishes the design is the waiting week: even with the signatures, the reset sits for seven days, and the owner can cancel it.
